## History

Hammond lived up the river with his wife, Mrs. Hammond, where he worked a little sawmill. Together, they raised eight children, including three sets of twins. After living there for over two years with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) in their household, Hammond passed away, causing his family to break up housekeeping.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)_
